cohort: 135 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated by high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) and uterine artery embolization (UAE), followed by suction curettage under hysteroscopic guidance
finding: Age ≥35 years, β-human chorionic gonadotropin ≤5000 mIU/mL, and longer duration of amenorrhea (>56 days) were risk factors for infertility after cesarean scar pregnancy.
